samples.question: Crates start in the four numbered bays shown; one bay is empty, and the magenta ring marks the queried crate. Read the six cards from left to right. Each card's color names a crate and its arrow gives a direction. That crate tries to move one bay. If crates are in the way, it pushes the whole touching chain one bay only when there is an empty bay before the edge; otherwise nothing moves. Which bay contains the ringed crate at the end? Answer 1, 2, 3, or 4.
